# Paperlogy webfont

Unmodified official WOFF2 faces from Freesentation/paperlogy, pinned at
8ef35f53b318c7ca914c52b1b382b9a8bad07a61. Source filenames and SHA256
are recorded in manifest.json; local filenames add an immutable hash prefix.
All nine faces contain all 11,172 modern Hangul syllables.

Copyright and redistribution terms are preserved in LICENSE.txt (SIL OFL 1.1).
No system-installed font or third-party CDN is needed.
